name: bto-cv
description: Convert original CVs into editable BTO Word documents using the shared R.R./A.F.R. layout and its native square bullet lists.

interface.shortDescription: Original CV in. Editable BTO Word CV out.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached original CV into an editable BTO Word document.
Create a fictional BTO Word CV to test the formatting and native bullet lists.
interface.longDescription: Create an editable .docx using the BTO reference banner, Century Gothic fonts, measured spacing and native square bullet lists. Preserves supplied facts. Includes a deterministic Word generator and optional HTML preview.
